verdict.rationale: Remote-management products can plausibly ship automation or script features, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no RustDesk automations at all, let alone versioning, review, or rollback of them. Centralized settings, audit logs, and the management API are related controls, not versioned automation management, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
